business_summary: Best Agrolife Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of agrochemical products in India and internationally. It offers insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, public-health, and plant growth regulator (PGR) products in the form of technical, intermediates, and novel formulations. The company also offers Ronfen, and insecticide; Nemagen, a novel insecticide combination; Defender, a dual-action insecticide + fungicide in WG form; Orisulam, a breakthrough herbicidal composition (GR formulation); Tricolor, a potent fungicidal formulation; and Warden Extra, a ternary SC formulation offering broad-spectrum control. In addition, it provides Tombo, a new generation corn herbicide; Azaro, a novel pre-emergence herbicide; Best Man, a deep-reaching translaminar power insecticide; Fetagen, a triple action shield, next generation insecticide; Citigen, first to launch in India post innovator; Shot Down, an comprehensive solution for the effective control of a wide range of weeds and Propique, registration-based herbicide. Further, the company offers Fluzam, a patented triple-action seed treatment; Midcotin; Cubax Power Extra, an enhanced formulation developed to improve product performance and farmer convenience; and Trishanku, next-generation formulation. It offers its products through a network of distributors. The company was formerly known as Sahyog Multibase Limited and changed its name to Best Agrolife Limited in October 2019. Best Agrolife Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.
